subject: Visibility Lite SKU and retention tiering — pricing/packaging questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jared Collins <jared@acme.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procure@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Visibility Lite SKU and retention tiering — initial pricing

Hi Jared / Acme team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. Attached is a concise breakdown of our proposed Visibility Lite add-on (observability) for your trial environment and expected production footprint. High level:

- Visibility Lite SKU (per-account): base includes 30-day traces + metrics retention, standard dashboards (viewer role)
- Retention add-ons: 90-day and 365-day buckets billed as usage credits; 90-day recommended for your expected 30k monthly trace insert rate
- Tracing: default sample retention (full span retention) vs aggregated sampling; priced by stored trace-units
- Advanced Dashboards: licensed as Editor seats (5 editors included), additional editors $XX/month each

I've highlighted two levers you asked about: 1) temporary extended retention during onboarding; 2) capped tracing sample rate to bound costs. See the attached Visibility_Pricing_v2.xlsx for per-unit math and three commitment scenarios (month-to-month, 12m commit, 24m commit).

Ask: Can you confirm target retention tier (30/90/365) you want for the first 90 days? Once confirmed, we can draft a short SOW and pricing addendum.

Regards,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Visibility_Pricing_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Jared Collins <jared@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Visibility Lite SKU and retention tiering — initial pricing

Soojin — thanks for the detail and the file. A couple quick clarifications before we escalate to procurement: 

1) We have a hard requirement to keep traces searchable for 180 days for our compliance team. Is there a blended price for an interim 180-day bucket (we're not willing to jump to 365/day pricing yet)?
2) For dashboards: our analytics team needs 8 editors, not 5. Can we get the first 3 editors at a discounted rate or included under the pilot?
3) Any ability to cap cost exposure? If ingestion spikes we want an automated throttle or cost cap.

If you can share a clear 90/180/365 comparison (per month cost and estimated monthly storage $) we can review with our SREs and procurement this week.

Best,
Jared
Jared Collins | Head of Platform
Acme Analytics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jared Collins <jared@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visibility Lite SKU and retention tiering — initial pricing

Jared — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses below and an initial concession we can offer as part of a pilot commitment: 

1) 180-day option: we can offer an interim 180-day retention bucket priced at 70% of the 365-day rate (prorated by stored trace-units). I'll include a 90/180/365 comparison in a short table.
2) Editors: we can include 8 Editor seats for the pilot (no additional editor fees) for the first 90 days; thereafter standard editor pricing applies unless you take a 12m commitment.
3) Cost caps: we support a soft cost cap + alerting in Console that can throttle non-critical ingestion and auto-notify. For a hard cap we can set an ingestion throttle policy + monthly overage limit; for pilot accounts we can set the hard cap at your request.

Concession: if you sign a 12-month add-on commitment within 14 days, we'll provide a 25% discount on Visibility Lite add-on list prices for year 1 and waive the SOW execution fee.

I've attached a refreshed SOW draft (VIS-Addons-SOW-draft.pdf) and updated pricing workbook. Marcus / Laura — I'm copying you for approval on the 180-day pricing rule and the pilot editor seat concession.

Thanks,
Soojin
---
Attachment: VIS-Addons-SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, draft SOW)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Visibility Lite SKU and retention tiering — internal pricing notes

Looping with a quick internal read — for ACME-2317 I recommend:

- Approve 180-day at 70% of 365 price as you proposed; keep math conservative for stored trace-units (assume +15% variation)
- Editor seats: include 8 editors for 90 days, then invoice additional editors monthly unless they commit to 12m (we could offer 10% off if they go 12m).
- Cost cap: allow hard cap for pilot but put a manual approval for overrides; we should not auto-burn credits without an alert and a 24-hour grace window.

Also — add a line in SOW about data egress/export format for compliance (JSONL export every 30 days). Laura, can you add that clause and update the SOW draft?

-Marcus
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jared Collins <jared@acme.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procure@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visibility Lite SKU and retention tiering — pilot counteroffer and next steps

Jared — thanks for the quick turnaround and good signal on priorities. Final pilot counterproposal below: 

- Retention: 30-day base included. Pilot (90 days) we will enable 180-day retention bucket at 70% of the 365 price. After pilot, you can select 90/180/365 tiers with a 30-day notice.
- Editors: 8 editor seats included for the 90-day pilot (no charge). Post-pilot: 5 editors included in base, additional editors $25/editor/month; 12m commitment -> 10% discount on editor licensing.
- Tracing: default sample retention policy with the option to store full traces for tagged services. We will configure a soft cost cap + alerts; hard cap available on request (will block ingestion if hit).
- Pricing concession: 20% discount applied to Visibility Lite add-on list pricing for year 1 if 12-month commitment signed within 14 days. (Marcus proposed 25% — to be conservative for legal/finance I can offer 20% in initial contract).
- SOW: attached draft and DocuSign link; include data-export clause for compliance as requested.

Next steps: if this is acceptable, confirm and we'll issue a SOW for signature and spin up the pilot environment. If you want Marcus' 25% number we can run an internal approval but that will take ~48 hours.

Regards,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
